name: A model's season
description: The model page's This season, over the game's live season (else the latest closed): the record -- the fold's own win, draw and loss counters on its versions' Open ratings, so rated matches only -- the last five as cards, the win that gained most and the loss that cost most on the Open ladder, and its Open rank now (ladder_field) and a week ago (the ladder_snapshots row at or before then). Everything but the rank reads the versions' Open rating_events, so it costs this model's matches and never the season's. 404 for an unknown model.
